description: Commit — behavioral commitment trust scores for npm, PyPI, Cargo, and Go packages. Catches single-publisher concentration risk the axios (March 30 2026) and LiteLLM (March 27 2026) supply chain attacks exploited.

audit_api.description: Score one or more packages. Body: {"packages":["axios","zod"]}. Send `Accept: application/json` for JSON; default returns text. Successful response shape: { count, results: [{ name, ecosystem, score, maintainers, githubContributors, weeklyDownloads, ageYears, trend, daysSinceLastPublish, hasProvenance, scorecardScore, hasDangerousWorkflow, riskFlags, scoreBreakdown }] }. Non-npm ecosystems via prefix ("pypi:litellm", "cargo:serde", "golang:github.com/gin-gonic/gin").
audit_api.auth: Anonymous: 15 req/day per IP (often CGN-shared). Free key (https://getcommit.dev/pricing) lifts to 200/day. Bearer key (Authorization: Bearer sk_commit_...) for paid tiers.

trust_page_api.description: Returns HTML page with the GitHub repository's commitment trust score and signal breakdown. For programmatic JSON, use audit_api above with the package name.

mcp.description: MCP server for querying Commit trust signals from agent context. 11 tools: audit_dependencies (batch up to 20 packages), audit_github_repo, audit_dependency_tree, lookup_npm_package, lookup_pypi_package, lookup_cargo_crate, lookup_go_module, lookup_github_repo, lookup_business (Norwegian business registry), lookup_business_by_org, query_commitment (browser-extension behavioral data).
mcp.auth: Anonymous: 15 calls/day per IP. With Bearer key (any tier, including free): unlimited.
